label: User Task
description: Work that a person must carry out. The workflow waits until the task is completed.

performers.label: Performers
performers.description: The people or groups who can complete this task. If none are chosen, no one can; "everyone" allows any signed-in user.

outcomeOptions.label: Outcomes
outcomeOptions.description: The choices the person can pick when finishing this task, e.g. "approved", "rejected". Later paths can depend on the choice.
